title: North Vietnam with the Ham Rong Trek
alt: Stone garden path on Ham Rong mountain above Sa Pa
transport: Private transfers, a mountain cable car and a cruise boat

activities.description: A full day with a guide through the Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the old quarter, with lunch included.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter, with a full guided day of the city and lunch included.

stops.name: Sa Pa
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel in the middle of Sa Pa town, near the lake

activities.name: Ham Rong mountain trek
activities.description: A climb through the rock gardens and orchid beds of Ham Rong to the cloud yard, with the whole Muong Hoa valley below.

activities.name: Fansipan mountain tour
activities.description: The cable car up Fansipan, the highest peak in Indochina, to the shrines and the viewing platform at the summit.

program.name: Sa Pa
program.description: Two nights in the hill town, with the climb up Ham Rong and the cable car to the summit of Fansipan.

program.name: Halong Bay

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Ham Rong is the walk people skip, and it gives you the best view of the valley without a full day of trekking.
expert.tip: Wear proper shoes for Ham Rong. The steps are stone and they are slick in the morning mist.

summary: Seven days in the north with two full days in the hills: a guided day of Hanoi with lunch, two nights at Sa Pa for the Ham Rong climb and the Fansipan cable car, then an overnight cruise among the limestone islands of Halong Bay.
included: Included: 6 nights with breakfast and dinner at the hotels, one of them on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a full day guided tour of Hanoi with lunch; the Ham Rong mountain trek; the Fansipan mountain tour with the cable car; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
